evidence.quote: Given the recent conclusion of the Board's stress test, it seems timely to share my thoughts on the stress testing program.
In my view, an up-calibration of capital requirements through an expanded scenario-testing regime would not be supportable based on the underlying risks.
Third, we should adjust the compliance framework for stress capital buffers.
